featured_reviews.name: PRANITA CHAVAN
featured_reviews.review_text:
Visited the newly opened restaurant Akshit today, and I must say — it was an amazing experience from start to finish!

🌱 Veg Dishes
🍽 Starters 🍽
• Hara Bhara Kebab – Really good, perfectly cooked and flavorful.

🍽 Main Course 🍽
• Veg Kolhapuri – Excellent! Full of authentic taste and spice.
• Paneer Hyderabadi Biryani – Superb. Just go for it. 100/100 without a doubt!

🍗 Non-Veg Dishes
🍽 Starters 🍽
• Hunan Chicken – Medium spicy and absolutely delicious. 101/100!
• Pahadi Chicken (Half) – Slightly on the creamy side but WOW. Excellent and totally loved it. Quantity is great. Half is enough for two people.
• Pomfret Tawa Fry – 10/10. Fresh, crispy and perfectly done.

🍽 Main Course 🍽
• Chicken Patiala – Comes in green gravy. It was decent, but not what we expected. Instead of regular chicken pieces in gravy, it had small chicken pieces stuffed inside an omelette, and the omelette was covered in green gravy. Interesting concept, but if you love spicy food, you might prefer going for their red gravy options.

🍞 Breads
We had Plain Roti, Garlic Naan, and Butter Naan — all fresh, soft and tasty.

🍹 Mocktails
• Virgin Mojito
• Watermelon Mojito
I’d rate the mocktails 7/10 — refreshing but can be improved slightly.

🍽 Quantity
One more major plus — the quantity is amazing! The portions are generous, and honestly, one dish is enough for two heavy eaters. Definitely value for money.

⭐ Service
The service was fantastic! The staff was attentive, quick, and made sure the spice levels were exactly how we wanted. Very swift service and extremely friendly staff.

Special mention to Joy and Devendra — they were wonderful and handled our orders perfectly. Honestly, the entire team deserves appreciation. Even though I couldn’t remember everyone’s name, they’ve truly hired excellent people to serve their customers.

🏡 Ambience & Facilities 🚗

The ambience is on another level — absolutely loved the concept! One of the best parts is the transparent glass kitchen, which lets you see how the food is being prepared. That openness adds a lot of trust and charm.

✔ Perfect cooling
✔ Big screen projector to watch matches — entertainment sorted!
✔ Cleanliness maintained throughout
✔ Comfortable seating
✔ Enough space for parties (can easily accommodate around 30–40 people)
✔ Ample parking space for 2-wheelers and 4-wheelers — even large enough to park 3 Volvo buses!

Overall, Akshit Restaurant delivers great food, amazing service, generous portions, and a beautiful ambience. Definitely worth visiting and highly recommended!
PS - They also do home delivery. 🌟

The food quality was so bad that none of my guests could eat it. To make matters worse, they promised to refund my money after I complained, but even after 4 days, I have received nothing. Adding to the frustration, they haven’t even bothered to collect their pot back.

This place is the epitome of unprofessionalism and irresponsibility. They ruined my event and caused unnecessary stress. Avoid them at all costs if you care about your sanity and reputation!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Hello Mr. Yadav,

We always appreciate feedback but prefer it to be fair and constructive. Let’s set the record straight with complete transparency:

We have reviewed your profile and seen your feedback about Barbeque Nation, where it seems the food didn't meet your expectations, along with a few other outlets. Given that, we may not place much weight on your average review. We, on the other hand, personally visit these places, and while we are in the same business, we genuinely appreciate their food. If your experiences don’t align, perhaps you should consider dining at Michelin-starred establishments.

1. The Root Cause: The issue with the rice occurred because it was freshly harvested from a new batch we specifically opened for your order. While fresh rice can sometimes result in slight texture variations, we tested the same batch with other team members, and they did not find it as disappointing as you have described.

2. Sample Approved: You picked up the sample beforehand, tasted it, and gave your approval. This makes your sudden dissatisfaction puzzling, especially since the same preparation process was followed for the final order.

3. Respectful Refund: The moment you provided feedback, we didn’t hesitate to offer a refund, despite the fact that your tone escalated with threats of a negative review. We respect every customer, even under such circumstances.

4. Price vs. Expectations: For ₹600/kg  Paneer Biryani (a price you negotiated from ₹600/kg and tried reducing to ₹550/kg), you seemed to expect gourmet-level biryani worthy of a five-star chef. To put this in perspective, high-end chefs charge significantly more, especially for large orders.

5. Pot: Asking us to collect the pot with leftovers still inside is unprofessional. Returning it clean, as is standard practice, would have been a simple gesture of mutual respect. Since we provide takeaways and delivery as a token of respect, and you came to collect a sample, I hope you understand. I agree where we are lagging, but be an effective communicator and then expect the same in return.

PS: You don’t need to disrespect the food, and as we mentioned during the call, you can recycle the pot. We will initiate your return as you have paid half payment ₹1500, but only once the pot is returned cleaned, since we didn’t promise delivery. If we are making this adjustment as a token of respect, we expect to be treated the same way.

We take pride in treating all customers professionally and upholding quality in our work. However, exaggerations and one-sided stories do not align with the mutual respect that makes association meaningful.

featured_reviews.name: Sharukh Shaikh
featured_reviews.review_text:
The atmosphere of the place was lively and enjoyable, with bright lights and upbeat music that created a fun vibe. However, the entertainment options were quite limited, especially for adults. The only notable game available was air hockey, which was entertaining but got repetitive quickly. For kids, there were a few small rides and arcade games, but older children and adults might find the selection underwhelming.

One major downside was the lack of staff presence. It was very difficult to get their attention, whether for assistance with games, ordering food, or resolving issues. This made the experience frustrating at times, as we often had to wait longer than expected for simple requests.

As for the food, it was average at best—nothing particularly memorable or outstanding. The options were typical of an arcade or family entertainment center (like pizza, fries, and burgers), but the quality and flavor were just okay.

Overall, it’s a decent spot for a quick outing with kids, but it could really benefit from more games for adults, better staffing, and improved food quality. If you’re looking for a place with a wide variety of activities, this might not be the best choice.

featured_reviews.name: Akshay
featured_reviews.review_text:
The Dhaba is the kind of place where hunger walks in and nostalgia walks out holding its hand. From the moment you step inside, the aroma of roasted spices and sizzling tadka wraps around you like a warm shawl. The decor usually leans rustic with charpai style seating, lantern inspired lights, and walls painted in earthy tones that whisper stories of highway pit stops and long road trips.

The menu is a celebration of North Indian comfort food. Butter chicken arrives glossy and rich, dal makhani simmers with slow cooked depth, and tandoori rotis puff up like proud little clouds fresh from the clay oven. Each dish feels hearty, generous, and unapologetically indulgent. The spices do not shout, they sing in harmony.

What makes The Dhaba special is the experience. It feels casual yet vibrant, perfect for family dinners, friendly get togethers, or those evenings when only soulful food will do. The staff is usually warm and attentive, adding to the welcoming atmosphere.

A meal at The Dhaba is not just about eating. It is about gathering, sharing, and savoring flavors that remind you of home cooked feasts and roadside adventures all at once.
